review.notes: Full review at the same head as the previous round (folder unchanged). Two P3 README wording findings: R01 the Shilov API bullet of section 4.3 uses 'affinoid domains' for integral-domain affinoid algebras and is false under the subdomain reading; R02 section 5.4 says the surjection onto T has 'the same underlying points' (false for the node) and its route has orphan labels (i)/(iv). Previous R01 (plan.json wording 'reduced resolution functor' for gap countable-resolution-invariants) is unchanged on the board; not carried as a finding against the folder, README line 140 is the correct sentence and is the one to announce. Checked: gate rerun (all scanners 0; worker gate build=0 OK); depcheck 235 roadmaps, 2133 edges, 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; #check of all 4 declarations, no lost binder; one-tactic probe (simp, rfl, infer_instance, simp_all, aesop) fails on all 3 theorems, no padding; 7 headlines, 3 stated and 4 named as not statable with the missing carrier; all 15 sampled targets read at their locators in CONRAD99, CONRAD10, CONRAD06, BH22, HK2, POINEAU13, TEMKIN12, STACKS and found to agree; 24 library declarations opened at the pins; citations of 10 suppliers resolved on main; ownership searched by object on main and open heads, no second owner; 5 declared gaps consistent between README and plan slugs. Not read: SCHNEIDER11, BARTENWERFER76, LUTKEBOHMERT74 (uncertified). Three source misprints recorded (BH22 one, HK2 two).
